create_cross_entropy_criterion: create a CrossEntropyCriterion instance for computing cross-entropy loss on language modeling samples
run_forward_loss: run the forward method to compute cross-entropy loss, sample size, and logging outputs for a model sample
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training into averaged loss metrics
register_cross_entropy_criterion: register CrossEntropyCriterion as the 'cross_entropy' criterion via the register_criterion decorator
test_cross_entropy_forward: test the cross entropy forward pass with reduced and unreduced loss modes
